CustomField.description: The Leave Type to try next when this one runs out of balance. Refresh Leave overflows to Annual leave; Annual, Sick and Personal leave overflow to Unpaid leave. Left blank the type never splits - which is right for Unpaid leave, the end of every chain, and for the statutory types that grant their entitlement as it is used. Must name a Leave Type that has its own active policy row.
CustomField.label: Overflow To
